registry_protocol_design.genesis: Versioned single initialization event with fixed producer/registry contract and immutable genesis digest; exact fields PENDING_REVIEW
registry_protocol_design.claim: Under exclusive lock, reject any duplicate ID/target, append one claim binding ID/auth/attempt/freeze/producer/target/timestamp, flush+fsync before transport or artifact
registry_protocol_design.artifact: Exclusive write after claim; include claim prefix length/SHA and producer SHA plus existing identity/safety/connectivity fields
registry_protocol_design.consumer: Under shared lock, parse full history, require exact one matching claim, verify claimed prefix bytes and current producer member hash, then enforce existing preflight gates
registry_protocol_design.mutable_log_policy: No full-file SHA in r11 immutable member inventory; later append is expected; truncate/rewrite/invalid suffix fails closed

rollback: Before any published r11 freeze, stop and revise only prospective code/drafts under the next explicit approval. After any formal freeze publication, preserve it append-only and use a later superseding revision; never overwrite r10/r11 or reset authorization/registry state.
